names.ice_cream_works_1605_indiana: 1605–1613 Indiana Avenue — the Thompson-Reid and Collins Bros. ice-cream works, building

source.citation: Real-estate column, Chicago Daily Tribune, 11 September 1904: the week's leases, among them one 'for Thompson-Reid Ice Cream Co.' of a second floor at the north-west corner of Wabash Avenue and Peck Court from 1 September 1904.
what_it_does_not_supply: how far the new plant's walls had risen by 1 July 1904
what_it_supplies: that Thompson-Reid let a floor of its Wabash and Peck Court premises from 1 September 1904
